description: This is a Swift test source file containing unit tests for various utility functions and components in the OpenClaw project, including age formatting, SSH target parsing, connection settings, gateway entry point resolution, log file selection, and handling of missing gateway entry points.

classes.name: UtilitiesTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing multiple unit test functions for utility features.

methods.name: `age strings cover common windows`
methods.description: Tests the age formatting function for various time intervals like just now, 1 minute, hours, yesterday, and days.

methods.name: parse SSH target supports user port and defaults
methods.description: Tests parsing SSH target strings with user, host, and port, including default port handling.

methods.name: sanitized target strips leading SSH prefix
methods.description: Tests connection settings parsing, ensuring SSH prefixes are removed and defaults are applied.

methods.name: gateway entrypoint prefers dist over bin
methods.description: Ensures the gateway entry point resolution prefers the 'dist/index.js' file if both are present.

methods.name: log locator picks newest log file
methods.description: Checks that the log locator selects the most recent log file based on modification date.

methods.name: gateway entrypoint nil when missing
methods.description: Verifies that the gateway entry point returns nil if no suitable files are found.
